attchmntText: GIC Housing Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Submission of Financial Highlights for the period ended September 30, 2026'.
voiceSummary: GIC Housing Finance Limited submitted financial highlights for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Profit after tax rose to 67 crore from 57 crore. Profit before tax increased to 89 crore from 41 crore. Total income was 545 crore. Interest income stood at 534 crore. The loan portfolio gross amount reached 11,261 crore. Net worth increased to 2150 crore. Earnings per share were 12.49. Net interest margin was 3.26 percent. Gross NPA percentage was 4.57 percent. Net NPA to net advances percentage was 2.16 percent. Return on net worth was 3.13 percent. Return on total assets was 0.59 percent. Cost to income ratio was 54.32 percent. Book value of share was 399.22. Credit ratings from ICRA and CRISIL remain stable with AA+ for long term loans and AA+ for non convertible debentures.

attchmntText: GIC Housing Finance Limited has submitted to the Exchange, Outcome of Board Meeting.
voiceSummary: GIC Housing Finance Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of 5,760 Lakh for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 1,085 Lakh for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, profit after tax was 6,845 Lakh. The board appointed Smt. Rita Mishra as Senior Vice President and Head of HR & Admin Department. The board also approved the Key Information Document for raising funds via Non-Convertible Debentures on a private placement basis. The trading window for dealing in company securities opens on November 15, 2026.
